svg.title: Молотковые сгибания гантелей сидя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. SEATED bilateral hammer dumbbell curl. Same short flat bench and both feet flat in both poses. Side-front three-quarter view to reveal the seat and both hands. LEFT arms hanging next to hips with one dumbbell in each hand, thumbs pointing forward. RIGHT elbows still by waist, bent and hands near shoulders. Thumbs point up throughout curl and palms face each other, dumbbell handles remain aligned with fists, recognizable dumbbells. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
